patch.value: Sponsor closed the study due to lack of response.

Part 1 is a phase 1b ascending dose-finding study for establishing the maximum tolerated dose (MTD) of tesevatinib (with trastuzumab).
Part 2 is a phase 2a expansion study with subjects assigned to 1 of 3 parallel groups who were administered the MTD of tesevatinib (with trastuzumab).
Safety: Number of Subjects Experiencing Adverse Events as a Measure of Safety and Tolerability and MTD
To determine the median progression-free survival (PFS) and the percentage of subjects without disease progression after 2, 4, and 6 months of dosing.
To determine the median overall survival (OS).

To evaluate the following pharmacokinetic parameter maximum concentration (Cmax) for the combination of tesevatinib and trastuzumab.
Plasma concentrations of tesevatinib and serum concentrations of trastuzumab will be summarized by dose, sample collection day, and sample collection time for each drug.
